info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Mahogany Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Mahogany Recliner Detail Management API allows businesses to streamline the process of adding detailed information about mahogany recliners to their product catalog. This API enables the enrichment of product listings with specifications, images, and features to enhance customer decision-making. Typical users include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems seeking to maintain an up-to-date catalog. By integrating this API, developers can ensure that product details are accurately represented, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a mahogany recliner. Ensure all necessary specifications and attributes are provided in the request body to successfully register the product details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a mahogany recliner. The client must provide all necessary information in the JSON format specified by the schema. Ensure that all required fields are included to successfully create or update the recliner details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the mahogany recliner.
